ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 88% high-intensity white pixels and 12% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area across both lobes. Focal black pigment cluster at the central notch/peduncle junction. Dark irregular fringe along the entire trailing edge. Three distinct, vertical parallel black marks on the upper right lobe. Sparse black stippling scattered across the lower quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees; apex obscured by surface water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the full trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks ranges from 3 to 15 pixels; extreme jagged topography observed at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear to slightly convex upward sweep of the leading edges; trailing edges exhibit a straight trajectory from the notch transitioning to a slight concavity toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast dark pixel clusters with irregular borders at the distal tips of both lobes, indicating heavy colonization or associated scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three parallel vertical linear marks on the upper-right lobe; multiple faint horizontal and diagonal linear scratches distributed across the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue margins and jagged profile at the lobe tips; multiple small nicks and indentations along the trailing edge boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'comma-shaped' black pigmentation marks located in the upper right quadrant of the ventral fluke surface.
